players.product: Lithography equipment for advanced packaging and package substrates: UX-5 steppers, direct imaging (DI) lithography equipment and DLT maskless lithography systems

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results briefing Q&A: Q1 FY ending March 2027 Major Questions and Answers (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A, CEO Takabumi Asahi presenting): stepper demand is extremely strong and adjusting delivery schedules is a key issue; for the current fiscal year and the next, demand now exceeds the company's production capacity. Customers are installing capacity sequentially, so deliveries are coordinated with their capex timing and levelled into the following fiscal year to minimize lost opportunities. It would be difficult to expand production capacity any further this fiscal year; the company plans to expand capacity in line with demand. Management confirmed the Industrial Processes lithography sales plan for the year assumes operation close to full capacity, as many customers aim to ramp rapidly from the second half of this fiscal year through the next.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results briefing Q&A: Q1 FY ending March 2027 Major Questions and Answers (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): for the DLT system, many customers are expected to begin mass production around FY2028; the projects with provisionally decided adoption are scheduled to be installed starting next fiscal year, and delivery-schedule coordination has just begun. Evaluations are underway at several more customers, with adoption decisions possible within the next few months at the earliest; the company has not yet reached a significant order volume but expects meaningful volumes once the system is adopted for mass production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results briefing Q&A: Q1 FY ending March 2027 Major Questions and Answers (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): as substrates evolve toward finer features and larger sizes, lithography equipment selection is expected to become more differentiated by application, but many customers prioritize stable mass-production quality and management does not expect a significant change in customers valuing the stepper's advantages. Both end users' preferences and substrate manufacturers (the direct users) influence equipment selection; the company is broadly in discussions with customers across Asia, including Japan. Its hybrid desmear products are being evaluated by customers for potential future use.

quarterly_data.quarter: Ushio results briefing Q&A: Q1 FY ending March 2027 Major Questions and Answers (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): the JPY 1.0 billion Q1 gain from reversing inventory valuation losses on lithography equipment (enabled by the order recovery) was only partly in the initial plan, and excluding it Q1 results were slightly above the internal plan; further reversals are possible if order confidence rises, though not expected to be significant. Demand for semiconductor-related light sources (including UV lamps for lithography equipment) has been somewhat stronger than expected. Several months into the year the acquired OSRAM business shows no significant change from initial assumptions, and management believes it can achieve its target of an operating margin of more than 10%, excluding one-time expenses, from next fiscal year onward.
quarterly_data.figure: valuation-loss reversal JPY 1.0 billion; OSRAM business operating margin target of more than 10% from next fiscal year
